_note: Prompting template commands. Sources: prompting/management/commands/reseed_default_template.py:1-26, reseed_review_template.py:1-26, reseed_test_template.py:1-26, revalidate_section_overrides.py:1-68; seed semantics prompting/seed.py:200-308; fragments prompting/fragments/__init__.py; names seed.py:29,99 + models.py:20; validation prompting/validation.py:323.

args.help: Overwrite the body of the existing global default row.

reseed_default_template.help: Refresh the global default PromptTemplate from the ordered fragments in apps/api/pi_dash/prompting/fragments/. Does not touch workspace-scoped templates. (:11-15)

args.help: Overwrite the body of the existing global review row.

reseed_review_template.help: Refresh the global ``review`` PromptTemplate from the body in pi_dash.prompting.seed.REVIEW_TEMPLATE_BODY. Does not touch workspace-scoped templates. (:11-15)

args.help: Overwrite the body of the existing global test row.

reseed_test_template.help: Refresh the global ``test`` PromptTemplate from the body in pi_dash.prompting.seed.TEST_TEMPLATE_BODY. Does not touch workspace-scoped templates. (:11-15)

args.help: Clear needs_attention on overrides that now validate cleanly.

revalidate_section_overrides.guarantee: never deletes or deactivates a row (:5-12 docstring)
revalidate_section_overrides.help: Re-validate active prompt-section overrides; flag broken ones. (:24)

loop.flag_branch: broken + not already flagged -> needs_attention=True, save(update_fields=['needs_attention','updated_at']), flagged++, WARNING 'flagged {workspace_id}/{section_key} (user={user_id}): {detail}' (:54-60)
loop.missing_key_rule: section_key not in registry.REGISTRY -> broken WITHOUT rendering, detail='section key no longer exists' (:40-41)
loop.validate_call: validate_override(section_key, body, workspace, user) (validation.py:323); OverrideValidationError -> broken, detail=str(exc) (:43-52). Already-flagged broken rows stay flagged silently (no recount).

revalidate_section_overrides.summary: checked {checked} active override(s): {flagged} newly flagged, {cleared} cleared. (style.SUCCESS, :66-68)

results.created: no row -> create(workspace=None, name, body, is_active=True, version=1)
results.refreshed: row exists AND force AND body differs -> body=body, version=(version or 0)+1, is_active=True, save(update_fields=['body','version','is_active','updated_at'])
results.skipped: row exists and (no force OR body identical) — note force with identical body is 'skipped', PORT
